binding_note: The admins are identified by the same-record binding user_teams.user_id + user_teams.team_id -> teams.team_name = 'Test Workspace' AND user_teams.role = 'admin'; the answer set is fixed (U03ROBERT23, U07MORGANFREE). obligations.name: Resolve the admins of Test Workspace
obligations.description: Select the users whose workspace_membership record (user_teams) for team_id resolving to teams.team_name='Test Workspace' has role='admin'. Job titles, informal mentions, and other role values (owner, guest, admin-of-a-different-workspace) do not satisfy this condition.

task_spec.text: Post the names of the admins of 'Test Workspace' in #random.

access_plan: Discover workspace admins via users.list/users.info scoped to team_id=T01WORKSPACE, reading each user's workspace membership role from user_teams; discover the destination via conversations.list filtered to the acting user's workspace to resolve the exact channel name 'random', confirmed by the acting user's existing channel_members row. The added negative records (a second workspace with its own admin, an owner-role user, a guest-role user, and an informal 'admin duties' mention in #general) are all discoverable through the same users.list/user_teams membership and conversations.history routes, but each fails the exact role+workspace binding required by the request.
